subject: PROGRESS+CLAIM texture-opus: variants gate-green (102/102 sampled formats draw incl. sRGB8 + integer via variants, ASan); RT 2a mostly in; CLAIM RT 2b raw/integer targets + translator ColorWriteTable binding
body: Verified (host): texture_format_frontend_test ASan full 102/102 formats status4, SRGB_VARIANTS drawn=2 carried=1, INTEGER_SAMPLER ok=1; cdylib cargo test 34/34, producer receipt 7/7. RT 2a: 24/28 (ABGR4 needs the profile's R4G4B4A4 COLOR_ATTACHMENT -> build_compute_bundle.py mali_texture_profile now adds it + R8/RG8 sRGB targets; changes the profile hash, so translator/pack cache keys change). sRGB targets with blending OFF need the translator's WriteSource::ColorWriteTable (Metal's exact 12-bit sRGB encode, a 4096-byte uvec4[256] buffer, metal2vulkan bind::color_write_table). CLAIM exact: air_bridge.rs generic_plan_mode one new WriteSource arm + GENERIC_COLOR_TABLE=10 + FFI tegu_air_color_write_table; air_bridge.h define/decl; render_encoder.inc tegu_generic_compile_matches (buffer kinds) and the generic request binding loop (one new branch binding a process-lifetime 4 KiB table buffer as a plain BUFFER binding). RT 2b (raw: R8/R16/RG8/RG16/R32/RG32/RGBA8/RGBA16/RGBA32 Uint/Sint/Snorm/Unorm16/Float32, RGB10A2Uint; blendable A8, R8_sRGB, RG8(+sRGB)): nord2_metal_render.c/.h n2r tables + Metal clear conversions (translator runtime clear_value.rs rules), blend_state.c raw opaque conversion formats (Mesa pan_format FMT hw), bridge clear_pixel pixel[16] (fixes a latent 16-byte read of pixel[8] for RGBA32F snapshots), air_bridge.rs RT lists. RG8 (30) changes from RAW16 (delta8) to Mesa's blendable R8G8B8A8/R8G8.
